evidence.note: Current project release/license evidence and Seamly project-forum confirmation show that Seamly2D exports but does not open DXF; a 2026 open issue reports vertex/edge metadata loss in export. It is not a round-trip receiver; no install, fixture, profile selection, or gate change occurred.

text: S512 rejects Seamly2D as a G04 receiver lead: project-community documentation confirms no DXF open/import path, so it cannot produce the required independent DXF round trip. A current open export-metadata issue is an additional caution, not proof of all-mode geometry loss. All V03 gates remain unchanged; next is an exact import-capable receiver/build with measured profile-specific round-trip evidence.
